messages:
Priya R: ACME security team pinged — they want SOC2 excerpts + an NDA before we can start POC access. They also asked about temporary access windows and IP allowlist.
Mike (Legal): We can issue a bridge letter + sign a standard mutual NDA. Bridge letters typically valid for 90 days. Confirm: do we want to allow redistribution to their external consultants? We usually say no.
Jordan - Security: We'll prepare a redacted SOC 2 Type 2 extract and a concise controls summary. For POC access we can do timeboxed read-only keys and an IP allowlist. We will assert EU data residency for their UK region.
Nora (AE): Customer asks for KMS details and whether we support customer-managed keys in Private. They also want to know SSO options for the POC.
Priya R: @Jordan can you also map the key controls briefly to SIG/CAIQ items? That will speed their vendor risk intake.
Jordan - Security: Yes. I'll include a one-page SIG mapping. Redaction rules: strip hostnames, internal service identifiers, employee lists. Deliverable: PDF via secure link after NDA executed.
Mike (Legal): I'll start the NDA DocuSign and attach the bridge letter template. Note: we need an explicit non-redistribution clause and a 90-day window. If ACME asks for longer, we can negotiate.
doc-bot: doc-requested: bridge_letter_template_v2 -> legal-queue
Priya R: Great. Once NDA signed, I'll provision POC creds: 48-hour tokens, scoped to read-only, limited endpoints.
Nora (AE): I'll set up a call with their security lead tomorrow 10am GMT to walk the controls summary.
Jordan - Security: Draft ready in ~2 hours; will post here and send secure link after NDA.
Priya R: Thanks team. I'll update the deal tracker with these milestones.
